text:
maria: FYI opening a tiny Terraform PR to add a gateway endpoint for S3 and an interface (PrivateLink) endpoint for Secrets Manager in prod VPC. Goal: backups + secrets fetches avoid public egress. Need a quick review before we cut the deploy next Tue.
jason: nice. which route tables/subnets will this touch? any risk of breaking existing NAT routing for batch jobs?
maria: gateway endpoint attaches to the three private route tables (private-rt-1/2/3) only. interface endpoint lives in the existing app-private subnets with SG allowing outbound to port 443 from app instances.
tyler: pls confirm: we won't remove NAT gateways — backups still use NAT for external sinks? also, which policy on the endpoint? default open or locked down?
maria: not removing NATs. Backups will prefer the S3 endpoint once the code change lands — we add s3:// region-aware path. Endpoint policies are restrictive (only allow PutObject/GetObject on our backup bucket). snippet in PR.
anuj: can you paste the TF snippet? quick sanity check for IAM/principals.
maria: here you go:

```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_gateway" {
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids = [for rt in var.private_route_table_ids : rt]
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-backups-${var.env}/*"
    }
  ]
}
POLICY
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "secrets_mgr_if" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.secretsmanager"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Interface"
  subnet_ids        = var.app_private_subnet_ids
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.ep_sg.id]
}
```
sophia: looks fine. For interface endpoint SG, make sure you allow response traffic (established) and only app CIDRs. also remember to enable private DNS for secretsmanager so SDKs auto-resolve.
maria: yes private_dns = true in the module. SG only allows app subnets + mgmt-bastion for debugging.
infra-bot: terraform plan summary for branch add/s3-secrets-endpoints

Plan: 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

+ aws_vpc_endpoint.s3_gateway
+ aws_vpc_endpoint.secrets_mgr_if

(see full plan in the PR comments)
jason: can you add a small integration test that uploads to backup bucket and fetches secret via SDK to validate, then we can merge? :eyes:
maria: yep will add a CI job calling the backup flow against the staging VPC and assert traffic stays in VPC via flow logs (simple check for no public IP src). PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
tyler: assigning myself and @jason to review. If no objections I'll merge after CI passes. remember to run `make tffmt` and `terraform fmt` in the branch.
anuj: quick note — if you enable the gateway endpoint, S3 access logs that depend on source IP might change. verify any log filters or analytics that expect NAT IPs.
maria: good call, will ping analytics. thanks all :thumbsup!
